description: Marine Depot Maintenance Command (MDMC) is requesting the procurement of the Keysight N7800A Calibration and Adjustment Software in order for the instrument to run efficiently and effectively. The Marine Corps Logistics Command (MARCORLOGCOM) Contracts Department, Albany, GA intends to solicit and contract with Keysight Technologies Inc (CAGE 7ZXR5) of Colorado Springs, Colorado on a Sole-Source basis.
